headlines.title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down
headlines.description: Leavitt, 28, is the youngest person to serve in the role. She will leave the Trump administration at the end of the month.

headlines.title: David Crowley upsets democratic socialist Francesca Hong in Wisconsin governor primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Crowley, the Milwaukee County executive backed by Gov. Tony Evers, narrowly defeated Hong, a democratic socialist state lawmaker, in the key battleground state.

headlines.title: Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP Senate primary runoff in South Carolina
headlines.description: Graham, the sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, will face another Republican in an Aug. 25 runoff for the party’s nomination, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Minnesota GOP picks Lisa Demuth over Trump-backed Mike Lindell for governor against Democrat Amy Klobuchar
headlines.description: Demuth, the state House speaker, defeated Trump-endorsed Lindell for the Republican nomination, NBC News projects, while Klobuchar romped in her primary.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. John Larson loses his primary to opponent calling for generational change
headlines.description: The 14-term Connecticut Democrat lost to former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin in a heavily blue district, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Democratic House candidate calls on party to ‘get better at making change’ after ousting incumbent
headlines.description: Former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin (D-Conn.) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss how he beat incumbent Rep. John Larson (D-Conn.) in his primary race after focusing his campaign on generational change.

headlines.title: Karoline Leavitt to step down as White House press secretary at end of August
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced that White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt will be stepping down from her role at the end of August. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on the announcement and Leavitt's time in the role.

headlines.title: Proposal backed by Trump administration would allow 401K and IRA funds to be used in riskier investments
headlines.description: Proposal backed by the Trump administration would allow 401K and Roth IRA funds into riskier investments like private equity, hedge funds and cryptocurrency. The administration says that it could yield higher returns, but critics argue that retirement savings should be highly-protected against risk. NBC News' Gretchen Morgenson discusses how this could affect your retirement.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Extremism expert charged in case on Southern Poverty Law Center informants
headlines.description: A former official at the Southern Poverty Law Center is now facing federal charges in connection with a case the Justice Department brought over the way the organization made payments to informants who provided details on extremist organizations.

headlines.title: John Hinckley Jr., who shot Ronald Reagan to impress Jodie Foster, says he wishes her well
headlines.description: John Hinckley Jr., who shot President Ronald Reagan in 1981 in an attempt to impress Jodie Foster, spoke out about the Academy Award-winning actor more than four decades after the assassination attempt.

headlines.title: Progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: Flanagan defeated Rep. Angie Craig, NBC News projects, in yet another nominating contest that exposed Democratic ideological divides.
